link.title: Text Algorithms in Bitbybit
link.description: Work with text in Bitbybit - split, join, replace and format strings, and turn them into 3D geometry. Text does real work in a configurator: engraving a customer's name onto a laser-cut part, labelling a dimension, building a file name for an export, or assembling a description from the options someone picked. These pages cover the string manipulation helpers, number-to-text formatting, and the text-to-geometry components that render a typeface into wires and solids you can extrude. Each example is shown in Rete, Blockly and TypeScript.
